title: Roles by permission not prose
situation: Prose rules in role definitions made agents literal and made evals measure obedience to that prose; role text that restated the examples primed the evals.
decision: What a role can see, reach and change is enforced by the harness's own permissions and by the freeze. What a role decides is checked by behavioral examples. A role's text holds the concepts it carries, in the design's own words, never a scenario's procedure: no example may be readable off a role definition.
consequences: Recorded in `roles`. Example: the assayer has only read tools in omp.
